evidence.limits: No whisper.srt yet; speech coded from burned-in captions (hook captions complete, later ones sampled once a second). The animated lesson cards (17 to 47 s) change faster than one frame a second in places, so some caption words are missing. Sound effects and music not determinable. Loudness is low and flat (about -25 to -35 dB) for most of the Reel, which suggests quiet speech or voiceover under music, but this was not heard. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Trailer for his new web series 'מתן מלמד עסקים': ten lessons on starting a business that earns five or six figures a month, available only on his YouTube page.
caption_vs_video_note: Caption announces the new series, ten lessons, available only on YouTube; the video is a trailer: an opening address, a TV-set title, a list of ten lesson cards with icons and an end card. The caption's '5 or even 6 figures a month' is not stated in the frames.

opening.first_frame: Matan in a white polo in a pink and violet studio with black shelves, mid-gesture and slightly blurred; yellow caption 'אני' starting at the right edge.
opening.s0_1: Speaks to camera; the caption builds up: 'אני הולך ללמד אתכם' then a second line begins; a gold club logo sits at the top right from 0.25 s.
opening.s1_3: 'אני הולך ללמד אתכם את כל מה שאני יודע' then 'על עולם העסקים' (from about 2 s).
opening.s3_5: Green 'בחינם' then 'בחינם לגמרי' (3 to 4 s), a whip-pan flash at about 4.25 s into a TV set with the title 'ברוכים הבאים לסדרת הרשת החדשה'.
opening.visual_hook: A direct-to-camera address in a bright studio, then a transition into a retro TV with the title.
opening.spoken_hook: Speech starts at 0 s: 'אני הולך ללמד אתכם את כל מה שאני יודע על עולם העסקים בחינם לגמרי' (0 to 4.4 s), then 'ברוכים הבאים לסדרת הרשת החדשה, מתן מלמד עסקים' at about 4.5 s (machine transcript).
opening.text_hook: אני הולך ללמד אתכם את כל מה שאני יודע על עולם העסקים בחינם לגמרי
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: 'אני הולך ללמד אתכם את כל מה שאני יודע' is a complete promise
opening.works_without_sound: yes: captions carry everything, icons add detail

visual.subject_placement: Centred waist-up in the first shots; in the lesson section he is replaced by icons on a dark grid; he returns at 22 s and 50 s.
visual.setting: Studio with a pink and violet gradient backdrop, black shelves, a flip chart and a plant; then graphic backgrounds
visual.color_contrast: pink and orange studio; the lesson section is black with a chalk grid and yellow text; high contrast
visual.props_and_gestures: A blue marker he fiddles with from 9 s, hands joined at 3 s; a flip chart with the words 'החבר הטוב' appears at 9 to 10 s.
visual.supporting_footage: A retro TV set, a lower-third 'מתן מלמד עסקים' (6 to 8 s), a shop icon with a money bag (17 to 21 s), ten lesson cards with icon images (brain, heart, shop with X, stock chart, org chart, treasure chest, price, handshake, banknote, CV, coins, manager), a close-up of banknotes (48 to 49 s), a club end card.
visual.persistent_branding: Gold club logo at the top right for most of the Reel (0.25 s to about 50 s)
visual.visual_progression: 0 to 4 s talking head; 4.25 s TV set title; 5 to 8 s talking head with a lower third; 9 to 16 s talking head with a flip chart; 17 to 21 s shop and money-bag icons; 22 s talking head; 24 to 47 s ten lesson cards with icons (about 2 to 4 s each); 48 to 49 s banknotes; 50 s talking head; 51 s dark flash; 52 to 57 s club end card.
visual.cover_matches_video: partly: the cover is a different studio shot on a blue background with banknotes and the club logo and the text 'מתן מלמד עסקים'; the Reel itself has a pink studio.
visual.ui_interference: Lesson captions sit at about 70 to 80 percent of the height, inside the bottom 35 percent zone; the logo sits in the top 14 percent.

editing.edit_function: Clarity: each lesson gets its own card and icon so a list of ten fits 20 s; the TV set and whip-pan frame it as a show trailer.
pacing_changes: t=4.25s: abrupt whip-pan to a title
t=24 to 47s: card per 1 to 4 s
t=51s: black flash to the end card
editing.ending: A club end card with a collage and the text 'כי מעל 1500 יזמים לא טועים!' for about 5.5 s after a last talking shot saying the business works for you day and night.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: the ten-lesson list invites screenshots or rereading; the trailer format suggests a series return.

sound.delivery: Direct address with steady pace; loudness is mostly -25 to -35 dB, quieter than other Reels (low recording level, not heard). The transcript shows clear continuous speech from 0 to 51.5 s, so it is a voice recording rather than music under the voice.
sound.sfx: inferred: a whoosh on the whip-pan at 4.25 s (not determinable)
sound.sync: Caption words appear in time with speech in the opening (word groups every 0.5 s); in the lesson section each card is on screen 1 to 4 s.

text.colour_coding: Yellow for narration; green for 'בחינם'; white for lesson numbers ('שיעור מספר 1:'); a red X over a shop on lesson 2.
text.placement: Centre or lower third; lesson cards use a white title at the top, an icon in the middle and yellow text at the bottom
text.style: Bold yellow sans with a dark outline; white numeral titles.
text.density_and_read_time: Two to eight words per caption; each lesson card is readable in 1 to 3 s.
text.language: Promotional and clear ('כל מה שאני יודע', 'בחינם לגמרי', 'שיעור מספר 3: ומה המודל העסקי של רוב העסקים').
text.caption_structure: A headline 'סדרת רשת חדשה' with series name, a note that it is only on YouTube, a line about ten detailed lessons on building a business of 5 or even 6 figures a month; emojis; no hashtags.
text.rtl_notes: Numerals and colons in 'שיעור מספר 1:' render with the colon on the left side of the number in some cards (':1 שיעור מספר'), as the sheets show ':1' at the left of the line, a minor RTL quirk.

story.setup: He announces a free series that teaches everything he knows about business.
story.stakes: Learning to start a business from zero and reach money working for you.
story.progression: Ten lesson topics: mindset, which business is forbidden to open, the business model, product, pricing, sales, money management, hiring, scaling profit, the stage of hiring a manager.
story.payoff: A promise that 'your business will be a money machine that works for you day and night'.
story.resolution: End card with a member count and the YouTube pointer in the caption.
story.payoff_delivered: partly: the lesson topics are named but not taught; the content is on YouTube
friction_points: t=5 to 16s: a talking stretch about a flip chart and a marker before the list - interpretation: a slow setup
t=24 to 47s: ten cards in 23 s with some captions faster than a second - interpretation: not every topic is readable
no visible link or keyword in the video - interpretation: the next step relies on the caption and on comments asking where to watch

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 26 comments, not representative: mostly praise; several ask where and when to watch ('איפה אפשר לצפות?', 'מתי פרק ראשון?'), one asks about Spotify, one challenges ('איזה עסקים אתה הקמת?').
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: Short replies including 'ביוטיוב, מתן מלמד עסקים' answering a viewer's where-to-watch question, plus emoji replies.

conversion.cta_timing: caption only (the video itself has no spoken or written link)
conversion.offer: A free ten-lesson web series on YouTube
conversion.benefit: Everything he knows about building a business, free
conversion.proof: A member count on the end card ('מעל 1500 יזמים')
conversion.funnel_entry_visible: No link or keyword in the video; the caption says the series is only on his YouTube page and a creator reply gives the channel name.
conversion.cta_fits_content: partly: the destination is clear in the caption but missing in the video
conversion.destination: his YouTube page (named in the caption and a reply); not shown in the video

rights_and_privacy: No third-party film. Stock-style icon graphics and a banknote background; the end card shows identifiable audience members at his events.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a free-value promise in the first three seconds, a visual list that makes ten lessons scannable, and a series framing; the many 'where can I watch' comments show it created demand.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: no on-screen link or keyword, flat quiet audio and a slow flip-chart stretch before the list; the offer is only a trailer.

standout_moments.what: Green 'בחינם לגמרי' on a hands-together gesture states the price (free) as the hook.
Whip-pan into a retro TV titled 'ברוכים הבאים לסדרת הרשת החדשה' frames the Reel as a show.
A red X over a shop icon on 'איזה סוג עסק אסור לכם להקים' makes a lesson teaser a warning.
